findings.label: Error logs will carry Prisma payloads
findings.issue: errorHandler logs err.stack for every unexpected error; Prisma validation/known-request errors embed invocation arguments, so once write paths exist field values (possibly passwordHash) would reach logs, which spec §7 forbids. Not live in Phase 2.
findings.action: In Phase 3/4, map known Prisma errors (P2002 -> 409, P2003 -> 400) and log only name/code for Prisma errors.

findings.label: No TLS path for the runtime DB connection
findings.issue: parseMysqlUrl discards the DATABASE_URL query string, so ssl options reach prisma migrate but never the runtime MariaDB adapter; with allowPublicKeyRetrieval off in production there is no way to connect to a managed MySQL 8 host.
findings.action: In Phase 7, add an explicit SSL option (env var or parsed query options) and verify against the chosen host.

findings.label: Release tooling in devDependencies
findings.issue: prisma (postinstall, build, migrate deploy) and tsx (prisma db seed) are devDependencies, so a production-only install breaks postinstall and the release/seed steps.
findings.action: In Phase 7, move them to dependencies or document a full install on the host.

findings.label: NODE_ENV defaults to development
findings.issue: An unset NODE_ENV on a host enables allowPublicKeyRetrieval and, once Phase 3 lands, non-Secure cookies (fail-open default).
findings.action: Require NODE_ENV explicitly, or derive the cookie Secure flag from an https FRONTEND_URL / fail startup on the mismatch.

findings.label: Concurrent seeds can double-insert sample tasks
findings.issue: task.count() followed by inserts takes no lock under REPEATABLE READ; two overlapping seed runs would both insert the 5 sample tasks and history.
findings.action: Take GET_LOCK / SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, or document the seed as a single-instance release step.

findings.label: Workflow table, enum parity and helpers untested
findings.issue: canPerformAction/getAvailableActions, parseMysqlUrl and the date-only helpers have no tests; nothing fails at compile time if shared enums drift from Prisma enums.
findings.action: In Phase 4, add unit tests and a type-level equality check between Prisma $Enums and shared enums; keep server enforcement atomic in updateMany rather than reusing canPerformAction.

findings.label: Seed idempotency has no automated test
findings.issue: Seed-twice evidence is manual; ARCHITECTURE §10 lists 'seed can be re-run safely' as an automated test.
findings.action: Add an automated seed re-run test by Phase 6.

findings.label: Password max length counts characters, not bytes
findings.issue: max(72) counts UTF-16 code units; multibyte passwords over 72 bytes are silently truncated by bcrypt.
findings.action: Validate UTF-8 byte length when POST /users is implemented.

findings.label: Stale ARCHITECTURE.md status line
findings.issue: Header still reads 'Phase 1 draft, awaiting approval' although D1-D10 are approved.
